name: Subject identity/version
minimumContent: Stable subject ID and assessed version.

name: Scope / architecture boundary
minimumContent: Organizational, solution, Product/capability and logical boundary.

name: External authority map
minimumContent: GEDRM/GEARM/GEAIRM, BPS/PIN, Product-family, policy/legal, Decision/action and other authorities relied upon.

name: ABB / responsibility mapping
minimumContent: Canonical/specialized ABB and embedded responsibility realization.

name: Registry / projection / compilation map
minimumContent: Applicable M09 Registries, HPD/RRG/SYNCTX/RGB/Realization Plan/Blueprint Binding/Compilation Record responsibilities.

name: Interaction Contract map
minimumContent: Material M12 interactions and contract obligations.

name: External Boundary map
minimumContent: Material M13 Boundary Families, Boundary Instances and EBCs.

name: Realization / Profile map
minimumContent: M14 Realization Pattern(s), Realization Units and Profile obligations.

name: Version/currentness/historical state
minimumContent: Material versions, effective/currentness state and assessment time.

name: Invariant assessment record
minimumContent: Applicability, mode, result, rationale and evidence references for M16-I01..I48.

name: Limitations / N/A / unresolved evidence
minimumContent: Explicit gaps, N/A rationale, indeterminate conditions and unresolved dependencies.

name: Accountability / retention
minimumContent: Accountable assessor/authority, assessment version/time and retained evidence location/reference.
